blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust inside CPG & Brands: the operating realities we design for, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

CPG brands compete on shelf, on shelf-image and on data: trade spend efficiency, retail execution truth, demand signal quality and now provenance claims. The brands that win industrialize the sell-side data relationship with retailers.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Retail & Consumer Goods level this capability reads as: verifiable certifications (organic, fair-trade) exchanged cryptographically (audit evidence automated). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

A fixed rhythm keeps progress visible from week one — here is the one we run. The first two weeks lock the baseline: your team and ours measure the current metric together and sign it. Weeks 3–8 carry the pilot on bounded scope — a single decision path, workflow, plant or portfolio — and a control owner on your side owns the evidence. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement, and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Missing a gate produces a documented decision to stop or redirect — never a silent extension.
